name: Newstead
summary: Newstead is a rural farmstead situated along the high road just east of Thoradin's Wall in the Arathi Highlands. Positioned at a vital crossroads between the Hillsbrad border and central Arathi, the settlement sits directly in the path of the region's simmering border conflicts.

sections.title: A Crossroads at the Wall
sections.body: Resting in western Arathi Highlands along the main thoroughfare into Hillsbrad Foothills, Newstead occupies prime rural land in a perpetually contested zone. With Thoradin's Wall looming nearby, travelers heading between Lordaeron and the southern kingdoms pass straight through these open fields. While once a quiet countryside estate known for livestock and farming, the breakdown of regional security and the ongoing clashes across Arathi make holding any open homestead an unyielding struggle.

faq.answer: Newstead sits along the main western road of the Arathi Highlands, just east of Thoradin's Wall before reaching the central plains of the territory.

faq.q: Why is this farmstead strategically significant?
faq.answer: Its proximity to Thoradin's Wall makes it one of the first major staging points along the road connecting Hillsbrad Foothills to Arathi. Anyone wishing to control the movement of troops and supplies across the western border must reckon with this position.

Historically a human farmstead, the estate is tied to regional locals such as Friar Farshire. However, the escalating conflict across Arathi leaves open homesteads constantly exposed to wandering beasts, bandits, and rival armies.

angles.text: For Alliance forces maintaining lines between Southshore and Refuge Pointe, keeping the road past Thoradin's Wall clear at Newstead is vital for regional communication.
With Hammerfall's presence contested across Arathi, western vantage points like Newstead threaten Horde travel corridors stretching south toward the Thandol Span.
